'''icebreath The Princess Doesn't Need Rescuing...''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[David Kangas|icebreath]]
* '''Published:''' 24 October 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rescue The Princess
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 RTP icebreath LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

... she can take care of herself!  Mains & Toys deck based off of the Rescue The Princess objective.

== Strategy ==

Free the Princess, get her to the War Room, and use the flipside of the objective to POOP your opponent's characters left and right.

Leia's Back (V) gives extra drain damage or pulls out/retrieves another Leia in case the one on table gets whacked.  Mace Windu and Padme team up to do some turn-by-turn direct damage, while Plo Kloon helps out on some tricky weapon and battle destiny draws.  Use the Lift Tubes and Lift Tube Escapes for tracking (and for moving R2 and Leia around a bit easier on the Death Star).  Blaster Deflection for character protection, On The Edge and Reflection for retrieval... that should just about do it.

So all-in-all, just free Leia and then battle and drain away.

Enjoy!

David Kangas

Ophidian Agent
